findings: Complete 98-line script verified against the sha256 above.
Runs the candidate release's schema audit (ops/hr-schema-audit.sh) before switching the application.
No direct Drizzle migration commands; no hardcoded migration-ledger row counts.
conditions_open: Packaged schema-audit script: verify the candidate release's ops/hr-schema-audit.sh is the reviewed, read-only version. Repository side done in PR #7: its sha256 is pinned in files.sha256 and a test asserts it contains only SELECT statements; the VPS run must confirm the deployer executes that exact path from the release.
CI/CD paths: repository side done in PR #7 (no workflow, npm lifecycle script or build step runs Drizzle migrations; see RUNBOOK section 9).

Service-startup paths: the systemd unit (ExecStart/ExecStartPre/EnvironmentFile), timers and crontabs on the VPS must be shown to contain no migration commands (evidence item in ADMIN_ACTION_REPORT.md).

Application startup: the release performs idempotent runtime DDL (ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS on users/roles/holidays, CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_settings) and, when system_settings.seed_version differs from the release's SEED_VERSION, a runtime reseed that UPSERTS role permissions (overwriting custom values for ROLE_DEFAULTS modules). Preflight now reports seed_version; apply refuses when a deploy would trigger the reseed. Repository side, PR #7: the reseed's permission writes are insert-only (app/api/hr/role-permission-seed.ts), and postdeploy diffs the access snapshot taken at apply. The candidate release must contain that change.

Evidence collection: the Stage 1 'evidence' command records the service unit, its start scripts, HR timers and crontabs (startup-paths.txt, scanned) and the candidate release (candidate.txt). Approve this review only when STAGE1_SUMMARY.md shows both clean.
